title: Pocketwire Vault Tier Eligibility and Retention Grid
content:
The Pocketwire Savings Vault is offered in six tiers ranked from 1 (lowest) to 6 (highest). Each tier has an entry requirement made of two parts, a minimum plan on the linked Pocketwire Personal Account and a minimum combined vault balance, and a retention figure used at the monthly tier review.

## Grid

| Rank | Tier | Minimum linked personal plan | Minimum combined vault balance | Balance to keep the tier | Consecutive reviews below tolerated before a downgrade |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Pocketwire Vault Essential | Pocketwire Core | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 |
| 2 | Pocketwire Vault Select | Pocketwire Core | $1000.00 | $1000.00 | 1 |
| 3 | Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Pocketwire Plus | $5000.00 | $5000.00 | 1 |
| 4 | Pocketwire Vault Premier | Pocketwire Prime | $20000.00 | $15000.00 | 1 |
| 5 | Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Pocketwire Onyx | $60000.00 | $50000.00 | 2 |
| 6 | Pocketwire Vault Private | Pocketwire Summit | $200000.00 | $150000.00 | 2 |

## Definitions

- **Minimum linked personal plan** is the lowest Pocketwire Personal Account plan at or above which the tier's plan requirement is met.
- **Minimum combined vault balance** is the combined balance across the customer's vaults that the tier's entry requirement calls for; a balance equal to the figure meets it.
- **Balance to keep the tier** is the average combined vault balance over the previous calendar month needed to keep the tier at the monthly review.
- **Consecutive reviews below tolerated** is the number of consecutive monthly reviews below the balance to keep the tier that are tolerated before a downgrade.

## Reading the grid (hypothetical)

- Pocketwire Vault Premier: the entry requirement is a linked plan at or above Pocketwire Prime together with a combined vault balance of at least $20000.00; the balance to keep the tier is an average of $15000.00, and 1 consecutive review below it is tolerated.
- Pocketwire Vault Reserve and Pocketwire Vault Private tolerate 2 consecutive reviews below; Pocketwire Vault Essential tolerates 0, and its balance to keep the tier is $0.00.
